Use the exact [3,4] example from the report to make clipping tangible. Then explain that Gaussian noise perturbs each update entry. The current code scales per-weight noise as C times the configured multiplier divided by the square root of the parameter count. Be clear that this prototype does not compute a privacy budget, has no secure aggregation or encryption, and makes no formal differential privacy claim.

name: text-126
text: FL result: saved 5-round dashboard evaluation (67.1% accuracy, 40.1% macro-F1, QWK 0.687). This later run was not in the report’s original results section.

The centralized comparison in the final report has EfficientNetB0 at 71.1% accuracy and 40.9% macro-F1; MobileNetV3Small at 63.3% and 42.0%. The current project’s saved five-round federated evaluation file contains 67.09% accuracy, 40.08% macro-F1, QWK 0.687 and MAE 0.547 on the same 550-image test split. The report’s Chapter 9 says federated metrics were not available when it was written; present the federated metric as a later saved dashboard evaluation, not as a figure from the submitted report. Severe-class recall is zero in this saved federated run, so do not imply robust five-class performance.

Sources: Supplied final project report, Tables 9.3 and 9.7, pp. 59 and 66; current reports/federated/evaluation.json, run_id 68688c55a1864640ab728b6f2032341c (five rounds, 550 test samples).
